lessons.trigger: runtime patch loads in a parent process
lessons.different_action: Prove real request execution in every relevant engine and TP worker; retain disabled control and exact code hashes.
lessons.verification: Pinned-image symbol audit and all-rank activation gate.

lessons.trigger: AICPU and AI Core operator durations overlap
lessons.different_action: Use phase/rank/stream interval unions and critical-path evidence, never add overlapping envelopes as removable latency.

lessons.trigger: custom multi-rank collective or failed IPC successor
lessons.different_action: Require explicit buffer ownership, fresh epochs, global rank decision, bounded waits and lifecycle stress; do not retry identical failing bytes.
lessons.verification: Fresh-process per-rank phase and recovery gates before E2E.

lessons.trigger: dataset has no populated reference answers
lessons.different_action: Use all-row paired semantic review; blank-answer exact matches are not accuracy. Review every changed pair.
lessons.verification: 357-row capture identities, errors, finishes, reviewer and material-regression count.

lessons.trigger: a later control repetition is much faster
lessons.different_action: Do not label control replay as treatment; freeze independent warmup, test unseen content and shapes, report readiness cost and matched-state latency.
lessons.verification: Checker rejects cold/warm control evidence as final optimization.

lessons.trigger: fresh controls or P50-only summaries are reused
lessons.different_action: Keep each denominator ID and percentile distinct; use raw P95 repetitions, preserve historical reference and audit dirty bytes as well as HEAD.
lessons.verification: Hash audit and checker reject percentile or denominator substitution.

lessons.trigger: a local microbenchmark improves but misses its gate
lessons.different_action: Retain negative evidence; do not round 1.0981x into 1.10x or multiply local deltas into claimed E2E wins.
lessons.verification: Independent ratio arithmetic and service translation gate.

lessons.different_action: Treat it as an ingredient; require the exact removable-plugin bytes to pass current full matrix and quality gates.
lessons.verification: Checker rejects source-overlay and incomplete-matrix promotion.

lessons.trigger: an operator-name filter or compilation timestamp is treated as exhaustive causality
lessons.different_action: Mark missing fused paths and correlation limits; require full name/shape mapping and request-phase attribution before excluding a candidate.
lessons.verification: README correction register explicitly keeps Candidate A unproven and JIT attribution partial.

lessons.different_action: Re-resolve peer, prove direct target, inspect absolute executable and cwd, then consult files/processes; never infer NPU failure from control-plane errors.
lessons.verification: Current /bin/sh and /usr/bin/python3 probes succeeded with explicit cwd; prior root cause remains unknown.

lessons.trigger: a clean lesson branch is ahead or a production tree is dirty
lessons.different_action: Validate and preserve named branch commits; privately back up dirty patch/untracked files, publish only owned files and state push status explicitly.
lessons.verification: Backup hashes, before/after worktree fingerprint and HEAD/upstream comparison.

lessons.trigger: service exited successfully but no benchmark artifact exists
lessons.different_action: Keep the experiment incomplete; distinguish startup, operation, benchmark, branch and integration states.
lessons.verification: Checker rejects missing benchmark and missing full acceptance evidence.
